fullText.simplified:
第2章、让人害怕的东西

    爸爸的旅游公司关门的时候，高尔才十六岁，刚刚上高一。虽然高尔的学习很好，老师也说他能去全国最好的大学，但他还是离开了学校。他要还爸爸欠银行的那些钱，他还要照顾突然老去的爸爸、身体不好的妈妈和只有九岁的妹妹，他需要一份工作。
    高尔的运气不错，找到了一份工作，在一家家具公司做小工。他每天早上六点出门上班，晚上十点半下班回家。工作很辛苦，但他很认真。现在，他已经在这家公司做了七年了。
    工作的七年里，高尔把全部工资都交给了家里。一部分爸爸拿去还钱给银行，一部分妈妈拿来买家里需要的东西，还有一部分给妹妹交学费。他每天都努力工作，一天也不愿意休息。家人在他的照顾下都过得很好。
    这天是星期三。早上五点半，高尔的闹钟响了，他要起床去上班了。
    今天有个很重要的会议，一定不能迟到。闹钟响第一声的时候，高尔就醒了。他睁开眼睛，想下床，但觉得全身没有一点儿力气。他用力，再用力，试了几次以后，他才慢慢地坐起来。
    这时候，他发现了问题！他看到了特别让人害怕的东西！
    他的脚不见了！往上看——他的腿不见了！再往上看——肚子也不见了！他的身体现在是另一个样子。这个样子不是人的样子，是一种虫子的样子。高尔以前在街边见过这种虫子，这是甲虫！
    “我变成了一只甲虫？！”高尔惊叫出声。
fullText.traditional:
第2章、讓人害怕的東西

    爸爸的旅遊公司關門的時候，高爾才十六歲，剛剛上高一。雖然高爾的學習很好，老師也說他能去全國最好的大學，但他還是離開了學校。他要還爸爸欠銀行的那些錢，他還要照顧突然老去的爸爸、身體不好的媽媽和只有九歲的妹妹，他需要一份工作。
    高爾的運氣不錯，找到了一份工作，在一家家具公司做小工。他每天早上六點出門上班，晚上十點半下班回家。工作很辛苦，但他很認真。現在，他已經在這家公司做了七年了。
    工作的七年裡，高爾把全部工資都交給了家裡。一部分爸爸拿去還錢給銀行，一部分媽媽拿來買家裡需要的東西，還有一部分給妹妹交學費。他每天都努力工作，一天也不願意休息。家人在他的照顧下都過得很好。
    這天是星期三。早上五點半，高爾的鬧鐘響了，他要起床去上班了。
    今天有個很重要的會議，一定不能遲到。鬧鐘響第一聲的時候，高爾就醒了。他睜開眼睛，想下床，但覺得全身沒有一點兒力氣。他用力，再用力，試了幾次以後，他才慢慢地坐起來。
    這時候，他發現了問題！他看到了特別讓人害怕的東西！
    他的腳不見了！往上看——他的腿不見了！再往上看——肚子也不見了！他的身體現在是另一個樣子。這個樣子不是人的樣子，是一種蟲子的樣子。高爾以前在街邊見過這種蟲子，這是甲蟲！
    “我變成了一隻甲蟲？！”高爾驚叫出聲。

sentences.english: When his father’s travel company closed down, Gao Er was only sixteen years old, just starting his first year of senior high school.

sentences.simplified: 虽然高尔的学习很好，老师也说他能去全国最好的大学，但他还是离开了学校。
sentences.traditional: 雖然高爾的學習很好，老師也說他能去全國最好的大學，但他還是離開了學校。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán gāo ěr de xué xí hěn hǎo lǎo shī yě shuō tā néng qù quán guó zuì hǎo de dà xué dàn tā hái shi lí kāi le xué xiào
sentences.english: Although Gao Er did very well in his studies, and his teacher said he could go to the best university in the country, he still left school.

sentences.simplified: 他要还爸爸欠银行的那些钱，
sentences.traditional: 他要還爸爸欠銀行的那些錢，
sentences.pinyin: tā yào huán bà ba qiàn yín háng de nà xiē qián
sentences.english: He needed to repay the money his father owed the bank.

sentences.simplified: 他还要照顾突然老去的爸爸、身体不好的妈妈和只有九岁的妹妹，他需要一份工作。
sentences.traditional: 他還要照顧突然老去的爸爸、身體不好的媽媽和只有九歲的妹妹，他需要一份工作。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái yào zhào gù tū rán lǎo qù de bà ba shēn tǐ bù hǎo de mā ma hé zhǐ yǒu jiǔ suì de mèi mei tā xū yào yí fèn gōng zuò
sentences.english: He also had to take care of his suddenly aging father, his sick mother, and his nine-year-old little sister. He needed a job.

sentences.simplified: 高尔的运气不错，找到了一份工作，在一家家具公司做小工。
sentences.traditional: 高爾的運氣不錯，找到了一份工作，在一家家具公司做小工。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr de yùn qi bú cuò zhǎo dào le yí fèn gōng zuò zài yì jiā jiā jù gōng sī zuò xiǎo gōng
sentences.english: Gao Er was quite lucky and found a job as a laborer at a furniture company.

sentences.simplified: 他每天早上六点出门上班，晚上十点半下班回家。
sentences.traditional: 他每天早上六點出門上班，晚上十點半下班回家。
sentences.pinyin: tā měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn chū mén shàng bān wǎn shang shí diǎn bàn xià bān huí jiā
sentences.english: He left for work at six o’clock each morning and came home from work at ten thirty each evening.

sentences.simplified: 工作很辛苦，但他很认真。现在，他已经在这家公司做了七年了。
sentences.traditional: 工作很辛苦，但他很認真。現在，他已經在這家公司做了七年了。
sentences.pinyin: gōng zuò hěn xīn kǔ dàn tā hěn rèn zhēn xiàn zài tā yǐ jīng zài zhè jiā gōng sī zuò le qī nián le
sentences.english: The work was very hard, but he was very diligent. He had now been working at this company for seven years.

sentences.simplified: 工作的七年里，高尔把全部工资都交给了家里。
sentences.traditional: 工作的七年裡，高爾把全部工資都交給了家裡。
sentences.pinyin: gōng zuò de qī nián lǐ gāo ěr bǎ quán bù gōng zī dōu jiāo gěi le jiā lǐ
sentences.english: In his seven years of working, Gao Er had given all his salary to his family.

sentences.simplified: 一部分爸爸拿去还钱给银行，一部分妈妈拿来买家里需要的东西，
sentences.traditional: 一部分爸爸拿去還錢給銀行，一部分媽媽拿來買家裡需要的東西，
sentences.pinyin: yí bù fèn bà ba ná qù huán qián gěi yín háng yí bù fèn mā ma ná lái mǎi jiā lǐ xū yào de dōng xi
sentences.english: Part of it was used by his father to repay the bank, part of it was used by his mother to buy things the family needed, ..

sentences.simplified: 还有一部分给妹妹交学费。
sentences.traditional: 還有一部分給妹妹交學費。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu yí bù fèn gěi mèi mei jiāo xué fèi
sentences.english: .. and another part was used to pay his little sister’s tuition fees.

sentences.simplified: 他每天都努力工作，一天也不愿意休息。
sentences.traditional: 他每天都努力工作，一天也不願意休息。
sentences.pinyin: tā měi tiān dōu nǔ lì gōng zuò yì tiān yě bú yuàn yì xiū xi
sentences.english: He worked hard every day and was unwilling to even take a day off.

sentences.simplified: 家人在他的照顾下都过得很好。
sentences.traditional: 家人在他的照顧下都過得很好。
sentences.pinyin: jiā rén zài tā de zhào gù xià dōu guò de hěn hǎo
sentences.english: Under his care, the family was doing very well.

sentences.simplified: 这天是星期三。
sentences.traditional: 這天是星期三。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiān shì xīng qī sān
sentences.english: Today was Wednesday.

sentences.simplified: 早上五点半，高尔的闹钟响了，他要起床去上班了。
sentences.traditional: 早上五點半，高爾的鬧鐘響了，他要起床去上班了。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo shang wǔ diǎn bàn gāo ěr de nào zhōng xiǎng le tā yào qǐ chuáng qù shàng bān le
sentences.english: At five thirty in the morning, Gao Er’s alarm clock rang. He had to get up and go to work.

sentences.simplified: 今天有个很重要的会议，一定不能迟到。
sentences.traditional: 今天有個很重要的會議，一定不能遲到。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān yǒu ge hěn zhòng yào de huì yì yí dìng bù néng chí dào
sentences.english: There was a very important meeting today, so he absolutely could not be late.

sentences.simplified: 闹钟响第一声的时候，高尔就醒了。
sentences.traditional: 鬧鐘響第一聲的時候，高爾就醒了。
sentences.pinyin: nào zhōng xiǎng dì yī shēng de shí hou gāo ěr jiù xǐng le
sentences.english: When the alarm clock rang the first time, Gao Er woke up.

sentences.simplified: 他睁开眼睛，想下床，但觉得全身没有一点儿力气。
sentences.traditional: 他睜開眼睛，想下床，但覺得全身沒有一點兒力氣。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhēng kāi yǎn jing xiǎng xià chuáng dàn jué de quán shēn méi yǒu yì diǎn'r lì qi
sentences.english: He opened his eyes, wanting to get out of bed, but felt that he had no strength in his body at all.

sentences.simplified: 他用力，再用力，试了几次以后，他才慢慢地坐起来。
sentences.traditional: 他用力，再用力，試了幾次以後，他才慢慢地坐起來。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòng lì zài yòng lì shì le jǐ cì yǐ hòu tā cái màn man de zuò qǐ lái
sentences.english: He exerted himself again and again. After several attempts, he finally slowly sat up.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，他发现了问题！他看到了特别让人害怕的东西！
sentences.traditional: 這時候，他發現了問題！他看到了特別讓人害怕的東西！
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou tā fā xiàn le wèn tí tā kàn dào le tè bié ràng rén hài pà de dōng xi
sentences.english: At that moment, he discovered the problem! He saw something particularly frightening!

sentences.simplified: 他的脚不见了！往上看——他的腿不见了！再往上看——肚子也不见了！
sentences.traditional: 他的腳不見了！往上看——他的腿不見了！再往上看——肚子也不見了！
sentences.pinyin: tā de jiǎo bú jiàn le wǎng shàng kàn tā de tuǐ bú jiàn le zài wǎng shàng kàn dù zi yě bú jiàn le
sentences.english: His feet had disappeared! He looked up—his legs had disappeared! He looked up again—his stomach had disappeared!

sentences.simplified: 他的身体现在是另一个样子。这个样子不是人的样子，是一种虫子的样子。
sentences.traditional: 他的身體現在是另一個樣子。這個樣子不是人的樣子，是一種蟲子的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shēn tǐ xiàn zài shì lìng yí ge yàng zi zhè ge yàng zi bú shì rén de yàng zi shì yì zhǒng chóng zi de yàng zi
sentences.english: His body looked different now. This didn’t look like a human. It looked like an insect.

sentences.simplified: 高尔以前在街边见过这种虫子，这是甲虫！
sentences.traditional: 高爾以前在街邊見過這種蟲子，這是甲蟲！
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr yǐ qián zài jiē biān jiàn guò zhè zhǒng chóng zi zhè shì jiǎ chóng
sentences.english: Gao Er had seen this kind of insect on the street before. It was a beetle!

sentences.simplified: “我变成了一只甲虫？！”高尔惊叫出声。
sentences.traditional: “我變成了一隻甲蟲？！”高爾驚叫出聲。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ biàn chéng le yì zhī jiǎ chóng gāo ěr jīng jiào chū shēng
sentences.english: “I’ve turned into a beetle?!” Gao Er screamed out loud.

sentence_translations: Chapter 2: Something Frightening
When his father’s travel company closed down, Gao Er was only sixteen years old, just starting his first year of senior high school.
Although Gao Er did very well in his studies, and his teacher said he could go to the best university in the country, he still left school.
He needed to repay the money his father owed the bank.
He also had to take care of his suddenly aging father, his sick mother, and his nine-year-old little sister. He needed a job.
Gao Er was quite lucky and found a job as a laborer at a furniture company.
He left for work at six o’clock each morning and came home from work at ten thirty each evening.
The work was very hard, but he was very diligent. He had now been working at this company for seven years.
In his seven years of working, Gao Er had given all his salary to his family.
Part of it was used by his father to repay the bank, part of it was used by his mother to buy things the family needed, ..
.. and another part was used to pay his little sister’s tuition fees.
He worked hard every day and was unwilling to even take a day off.
Under his care, the family was doing very well.
Today was Wednesday.
At five thirty in the morning, Gao Er’s alarm clock rang. He had to get up and go to work.
There was a very important meeting today, so he absolutely could not be late.
When the alarm clock rang the first time, Gao Er woke up.
He opened his eyes, wanting to get out of bed, but felt that he had no strength in his body at all.
He exerted himself again and again. After several attempts, he finally slowly sat up.
At that moment, he discovered the problem! He saw something particularly frightening!
His feet had disappeared! He looked up—his legs had disappeared! He looked up again—his stomach had disappeared!
His body looked different now. This didn’t look like a human. It looked like an insect.
Gao Er had seen this kind of insect on the street before. It was a beetle!
“I’ve turned into a beetle?!” Gao Er screamed out loud.
